lines: Plucked the rank murk, burnt each birth-faggot whole:
be my ken-lamp, Lord, my love-lamp.
l4.sanskrit_cite: hṛtoddhatatamastāntiḥ pluṣṭāśeṣabhavendhanā tvadbodhadīpikā me 'stu nātha tvadbhaktidīpikā

reads_against.argmap: Dispersing surging darkness, having burned all becoming-fuel. → May awareness- and devotion-lamps burn darkness and fuel.
c1_essence: Twin lamps of waking and love begged; triple play staged and only poet fit to strike.

l2.plain_english: Scatter the surging gloom, burn every stick of becoming — be my lamp of waking, lord, my lamp of love.
l2.sanskrit_cite: hṛtoddhatatamastāntiḥ pluṣṭāśeṣabhavendhanā tvadbodhadīpikā me 'stu nātha tvadbhaktidīpikā
